families.name: Fern
families.intent: Two flat Native links, recolored for Home.

families.name: Ember
families.intent: Two flat Native links, recolored for Home.

families.name: Prism
families.intent: Native’s flat spectrum treatment, with deeper inks on light pages and brighter colors on dark pages.

families.name: Arcade
families.intent: Two flat Native links, recolored for Home.

families.name: Halloween
families.intent: The existing Halloween Home ghosts, preserved as editable vector artwork. Dev gains its own cool palette.

families.name: Día de Muertos
families.intent: Marigold and rosa links beneath cut-paper flags, with three cempasúchil blossoms and two votives. Remembrance treatment.

families.name: Día de Muertos · Sugar Skull
families.intent: A fully painted flat calavera, with flower eyes, cheek leaves, marigolds and a small Native forehead inlay.

families.name: New Year
families.intent: Champagne sparkler links with two broad firework bursts and a few falling ribbons.

families.name: Valentine’s Day
families.intent: Rose and carmine links, a climbing heart vine and one larger floating heart.

families.name: St Patrick’s Day
families.intent: The links grow into a shamrock sprig, with a broad emerald and gold botanical rhythm.

families.name: Spring Festival
families.intent: Red and gold papercut blossom links with a suspended lantern.

families.name: Seollal
families.intent: Saekdong-colored cloth bands on the right link, finished with a small tied ribbon.

families.name: Tết Nguyên Đán
families.intent: Apricot and peach blossoms grow along red Native links, with a flowering branch above.

families.name: Lantern Festival
families.intent: The Native links take on paper-lantern ribs and tassels, with two lanterns hanging from their upper edges.

families.name: Mid Autumn
families.intent: A harvest moon rises through the blue links, with small flat cloud curls.

families.name: Tết Trung Thu
families.intent: A five-point bamboo-style star lantern rises above magenta and gold links, with two ribbon tails.

families.name: Chuseok
families.intent: Moonlit harvest links with a rice sprig and two simple songpyeon forms below.

families.name: Nowruz
families.intent: Hyacinth blossoms and fresh spring leaves emerge from the Native links.

families.name: Songkran
families.intent: The links curl into flat water splashes, with frangipani and falling droplets.

families.name: Matariki
families.intent: Nine named-star-inspired points above a quiet blue interlock. No borrowed Māori patterns or traditional artwork; grouping is illustrative, not a navigation chart.

families.name: Kwanzaa
families.intent: Red and green woven links beneath a seven-candle kinara: three red, central black, three green. The center candle has an outline on dark pages.

families.name: Pride
families.intent: Six broad flat Pride colors flow through both Native links.

families.name: Carnival
families.intent: Purple, green and gold carnival links, with broad feather silhouettes and bead details.

families.name: Christmas
families.intent: One candy-cane link and one holly link, finished with a large sprig. No snow is baked into the design.

families.name: Easter
families.intent: Rabbit ears grow from the right link; a small painted egg and flower inlays keep the Easter identity clear.

families.name: Orthodox Pascha
families.intent: Red and gold links with a tall Paschal candle and a red egg, distinct from the Western Easter edition.

families.name: Holi
families.intent: Large flat pigment splashes cross the links, with a few loose colored powder dots.

families.name: Diwali
families.intent: Warm rangoli-like linework and four small lamps integrated into the links, with a larger diya below.

families.name: Vaisakhi
families.intent: Saffron and blue harvest links with wheat sprigs, keeping Vaisakhi distinct from the other illumination editions.

families.name: Bandi Chhor Divas
families.intent: Blue and gold linked illumination, with a quiet row of lamps and no borrowed sacred emblem.

families.name: Guru Nanak’s Gurpurab
families.intent: Calm gold botanical links under a soft sunburst, with a single warm lamp.

families.name: Eid Al Fitr
families.intent: Cool geometric links beneath a flat crescent and star.

families.name: Eid Al Adha
families.intent: Warm olive and gold links with eight-point geometry and two olive-like sprigs; a separate Eid al-Adha treatment.

families.name: Hanukkah
families.intent: A nine-light hanukkiah: eight equal candle positions and one raised central shamash. Blue and silver links stay uncluttered.

families.name: Vesak
families.intent: Two lotus blossoms grow from soft green and rose links, without a generic party treatment.

families.name: Meskel
families.intent: Golden daisy-like flowers along both links and a small abstract bonfire above, following the existing Meskel app artwork.

families.name: Timkat
families.intent: White textile-like crosses and water curls on blue links, with a central descending droplet.

families.name: Earth Day
families.intent: Living leaf shapes grow directly from green and blue Native links.

families.name: Juneteenth
families.intent: Red and blue links, a rising arc and a bright star within a broader burst, informed by the Juneteenth freedom-star motif.

families.name: Thanksgiving · Canada
families.intent: Autumn wheat links with a broad maple leaf growing from the right fold.

families.name: Thanksgiving · US
families.intent: Harvest-gold wheat links with a compact pumpkin nestled at the upper fold.

families.name: Pi Day
families.intent: A bold pi symbol rests above the Native links, with broad mathematical curves and construction circles.

families.name: Programmers’ Day
families.intent: Phosphor circuit traces are integrated into the links, with a broad terminal chevron and cursor.

families.name: Ada Lovelace Day
families.intent: Brass and ink links become original punched cards, including real transparent holes and one loose card.

families.name: Personal Celebration
families.intent: A gift-ribbon Native interlock with a tied bow, broad sprinkles and six pieces of confetti.

families.name: Fourth of July
families.intent: Original stars-and-stripes links and two red, blue and gold fireworks for the Fourth of July.

families.name: Southern Cross
families.intent: A simple Native interlock beneath the correctly proportioned five-star Southern Cross. No Union Jack.

families.name: Wattle
families.intent: Green and gold links grow into wattle, using broad leaf blades and clustered golden flower balls.

families.name: Reflection
families.intent: Quiet eucalyptus-like leaves and seed pods on sage links, without flag or party details.

families.name: Boxing Kangaroo
families.intent: An original flat boxing kangaroo with red gloves, Native belly inlay and a correctly proportioned Southern Cross. Not a traced flag mascot.

families.name: Ochre Dots · Original Study
families.intent: Original abstract ochre dot-pattern study on the Native links. No Aboriginal authorship claim, cultural symbols, stories or copied pattern.

integration: Artwork delivery only. App and plugin code are unchanged. These Home images have no macOS tile, shadow, or Icon Composer material; keep their transparent canvas and Native emblem anchor when integrating.

all.role: Existing catalogue and researched motif directions. Original artwork; no downloaded reference images included.

matariki.role: Seven- and nine-star traditions. This edition uses nine points in an illustrative grouping; no traditional art is copied.

australia-day.role: Factual Southern Cross star arrangement and point counts, drawn as new SVG geometry.

australia-day-boxing-kangaroo.source: User-supplied green-and-gold Boxing Kangaroo flag reference
australia-day-boxing-kangaroo.role: Color and subject inspiration only. Original flat kangaroo, not the flag artwork.

australia-day-ochre-dots.role: Original abstract dot-pattern study, not represented as Aboriginal artwork. No cultural symbols or story.
